ev.q: squad-based multiplayer first-person shooter video game
squad-based multiplayer first-person shooter video game
There are 4 game modes: Frontlines, Attrition Warfare, Squad Defense and Rifle Deathmatch
The game includes historically accurate World War I weapons
each with a unique role that is also typically made up of a squad leader called an NCO
gaining bonus abilities and upgrades on their preexisting abilities
